# Master Services Agreement

This Agreement is dated 2026-06-01 between Helvetia Rail ("Client") and Atlas Robotics ("Provider").

## Obligations
- Provider shall deliver monthly uptime reports
- Client shall pay invoices within 30 days of receipt
- Either party may terminate with 60 days written notice

## Liability
Indemnification is limited to fees paid in the prior twelve months.
Governing law: Switzerland.
